design: The wait lives inside deploy/bootstrap/services/temporal/qualify.py --execute: the sealed REM-0038 test pins _run_qualify_script(repository, script, ['--execute']) with a three-positional-argument fake, so the runner call shape of check_temporal is unchanged.

qualify.py --execute reaches the server runtime (running, healthy, loopback-only frontend) and the protocol (TCP publication, cluster health SERVING, server version of the lock, absent namespace refused) through the existing bounded wait_ready with STARTUP_WAIT_SECONDS = 90.0; the required outcome is exactly the one of the single probe; without --execute the probe stays a single observation; lock errors are not waited for.
scripts/verify_external_services.py bounds only the Temporal qualification subprocess at 240 s (90 s wait plus one bounded attempt and two private inspections); every other script keeps 60 s.

Input robustness (self-check and preventive review): every parsing path of qualify.py refuses malformed, non-text or undecodable input with QualificationError, which wait_ready retries within its bound; check_temporal maps runner failures and malformed payloads to a typed UNREACHABLE outcome, confined to Temporal as option B1 requires.
No test, timeout of the suite, criterion, workflow, guard, contract or register changes; the two NCP-U08 decision request files enter main byte-identical with their disposition commits.
